$comment: The integriq synchronization the developer.overheid.nl harvest flow pages through (openspec/changes/publiccode-developer-overheid-harvest, design D8). PubliccodeHarvestService::setUp(harvest: 'developer-overheid') writes each entry into integriq when an administrator sets the harvest up, updating it in place by slug; the flow's node with the same `node` id names it. `source` is the source the list call goes to and the section checks; `sources` are the raw-file sources the section also checks. maxPages 10 covers 1,000 repositories, ten times the register's size on 2026-10-16; past that the list step raises rather than silently truncating, so raise the number here. The API key is never in this file or in OpenCatalogi: the administrator stores it as a generic-apikey credential named developer-overheid-oss, which integriq adds to every request to the source. tests/Unit/Settings/DeveloperOverheidHarvestFlowTest.php keeps this file and the flow in step.

synchronizations.name: developer.overheid.nl OSS-register, repositories with a publiccode.yml
